test_item_verbatim: a. The head unit shall display the rear camera image display.

tcs.tc_title: rear camera image displayed (analog, second section), engage reverse and check that the rear camera image is displayed
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. PROXI Rear_View_Camera_Type = 0 (Analogic)
4. No camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition = 2 (R)
2. Read the HU display and check that the rear camera image is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition = 2 (R) is sent
2. The rear camera image is displayed
tcs.split_reason: rear camera image displayed (analog, second section)
